Class GlobalJobInfoList

java.lang.Object
QueueNet.GlobalJobInfoList
public class GlobalJobInfoList extends Object

Title: Global Job Info List

Description: This class provides a global "job info list" to be used during simulation to compute global measures. This is designed to be associated to a simulation object.

Author:
Bertoli Marco Date: 8-mar-2006 Time: 12.27.42 Modified by Ashanka (Feb 2010) Desc: Modified the logic of System Power calculation. Earlier the logic was to capture the response time (rn) of each job when it was entering the sink and to capture the time of throughput (xn) for each job. Then x1/r1 ... x2/r2 ... x3/r3 ... was sent for System Power Simulation Engine. This logic was modified into: x1/r1 .. [x1/r1 + (x1+x2)/(r1+r2)] .. [x1/r1 + (x1+x2)/(r1+r2) + (x1+x2+x3)/(r1+r2+r3)] ..
